narrative.northStar: The Ledger of What the Server Decided
narrative.overview:
The Console is an operating surface for sellers and their teams, used in sunlight on mid-range Android and on desktop. It does not decorate. Each screen reads as ruled rows of fact: a requirement or obligation, its status in words with a drawn mark, and its one resolving action. The console computes no business state, so the interface shows what the server resolved and nothing it invented.

The shell is conventional on purpose; the distinctiveness sits inside the content area, in the ledger. The palette is the founder-approved cool neutral ramp with near-black action and a single lime accent. Light only.
keyCharacteristics: Ruled-row ledger sections rather than boxed cards; rows, not tiles.
Status is always a drawn icon plus a word; colour only reinforces.
Near-black is the action colour; lime marks the one standout action per screen.
One system font stack, fixed rem scale, tabular numerals for times.
Flat: tonal layers and hairlines carry depth, shadows are almost absent.
44px minimum targets, a visible 2px ink focus ring, reduced-motion respected.

rules.name: The One Lime Rule
rules.body: Lime appears once per screen, on the single standout action, with Ink text and an Ink border. A second lime element is a defect.

rules.name: The Never Colour Alone Rule
rules.body: No state is carried by colour alone. A status is a badge with a drawn icon and a word.

rules.name: The Role Not Hex Rule
rules.body: All colour comes from the shared token custom properties. No literal colour appears in the stylesheet or in components.

rules.name: The No Fixed Height Rule
rules.body: Nothing holding text has a fixed height; lengths that scale with text are rem.

rules.name: The Flat Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Rules and tone separate; shadows are reserved for the modal dialog.

dos: Do express a requirement as a ledger row: title, meta, status badge, its one resolving action.
Do pair every status with a drawn icon and a word.
Do keep lime to the single standout action per screen, with Ink text and Ink border.
Do take every colour, size, space and radius from the shared token properties.
Do keep targets at 44px or more and every list with an empty state.
Do show unbuilt steps as disabled controls with a plain reason.
Do let text wrap; use rem, never fixed heights on text.
donts: Don't nest boxes: a state, notice or ledger inside a panel loses its own border and fill.
Don't use metric tiles or a grid of equal cards for Home.
Don't carry state by colour alone.
Don't use lime as text or decoration, or twice on one screen.
Don't add a dark theme, a second font family, or literal colours.
Don't pin the top bar below 1024px, where it takes half a phone screen.
Don't link to destinations that do not exist yet.
